body_html:
Introducing Kirkland, the dynamic DJ who goes by the name Over/Time. Hailing from the vibrant state of Georgia, Kirkland brings to the turntables a unique blend of skills and experiences that set him apart in the world of entertainment. With a diverse background in Project Management, Coaching, and Teaching, his ability to take charge as an emcee and lead a crowd is truly unparalleled.

What truly fuels Kirkland’s passion for DJing is the electrifying connection he forges with the audience. He thrives on making the crowd groove and ensuring they have an unforgettable time.

When it comes to his musical preferences, Kirkland’s heart beats to the rhythm of 90s and early 2000s R&B and Pop. Some of his all-time favorite tracks to mix into his sets include Drake’s “Nice For What,” Miley Cyrus’s “Party In The USA,” Biggie Smalls & Puff Daddy’s “Mo Money Mo Problems,” and Backstreet Boys’ “Everybody.”

Outside of the DJ booth, you can find Kirkland indulging in his other passions, particularly Spin/Cycling. In fact, he’s not just a fan; he’s also a dedicated coach in the Spin/Cycling world.

Kirkland’s performances are synonymous with high energy, both in terms of the events he curates and the music he spins. His extraordinary ability to seamlessly beatmatch and blend tracks ensures that every moment on the dance floor is a non-stop thrill ride.

When it’s Over/Time on the decks, expect nothing less than a top-tier, professionally executed, and immensely enjoyable DJ experience that will leave you wanting more. Kirkland is not just a DJ; he’s the maestro of the musical journey you’ve been waiting for.
